detailZh: “高风险”与“混乱”的可能——车手们畅谈F1新马德里赛道
随着狂野的马德里赛道周五正式亮相，首批车手对F1西班牙大奖赛新家的评价已经出炉
西班牙大奖赛的马德里赛道获得了多位F1领军人物的肯定，他们称赞这条赛道布局极具挑战性，但并非所有人都对其印象深刻。
车手们已在模拟器上体验了这条5.4公里的赛道，预计本周末将是全年最具挑战性的比赛之一，因为该赛道兼具街道赛的严苛特性与诸多中高速弯角。但没有什么能比得上真实赛道，在两节各一小时的练习赛后——车手们明显格外小心，以免因缺乏缓冲区而吃亏——对F1最新赛道的首批评价已经出炉。
“老实说，它比一些赛道更难，”奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里说，他当天排名第五，迈凯伦相比对手表现挣扎。“这里有很多路段，你并不是真的擦着墙过，而是朝着墙转向或行驶，然后你需要避开它们。所以，这让事情相当具有挑战性。大家仍在适应速度，但当你在单圈中找到不错的节奏时，还是挺享受的。”
除了小红牛车队速度飞快的阿尔维德·林德布拉德在FP2撞车外，当天的F1环节没有出现重大问题。赛道的组合刹车区造成了不少麻烦，车手们小心避免锁死，而轮胎磨损、快速变化的抓地力和交通状况被证明是最大的难题。
法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔说：“今天在马德里赛道上驾驶很兴奋。这是一条具有挑战性的街道赛道，通常是我喜欢的那种类型，这条也不例外。考虑到这是一条全新的赛道，目前橡胶还不多，我对已有的抓地力水平相当印象深刻。”
由于队友基米·安东内利占据圈速榜首，乔治·拉塞尔的练习日再次印证了他的想法：马德里赛道是一条“非常高风险赛道”，不过他担心超车会“非常困难”，这一观点在围场内得到广泛认同。
最大的正面声音来自马德里居民塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯，他对自己的凯迪拉克赛车表现没什么可夸耀的，但对马德里赛道无论场上场下都赞不绝口。“是的，非常酷的赛道，非常棒的场地，”这位墨西哥人说。“真的很高兴来到马德里。我认为这绝对会成为欧洲最好的比赛。”
“明天的排位赛将会很混乱，显然周日的正赛也会非常混乱，所以很多事情都可能发生。我非常期待，作为车队，我们只需确保能够执行一个完美的周末。”
不过，并非所有人都像佩雷斯那样热情。马克斯·维斯塔潘从来都不是街道赛的最大粉丝，马德里赛道所提供的一切并未改变他的看法。
“是的，我不知道。我不是街道赛的粉丝，所以这永远不会改变，”这位四届世界冠军说。“我总是更喜欢在像斯帕这样的赛道上驾驶。我的意思是，他们建造一切的方式，我认为他们做得非常出色。但我不是街道赛的粉丝。”
虽然马德里赛道对F1 2026年能量匮乏的动力单元来说并不特别苛刻，但让车手和车队都感到失衡的是快速演变的赛道对能量部署方式的影响。这对本田动力阿斯顿·马丁的费尔南多·阿隆索来说尤其困难，他从离合器问题中恢复过来，完成了FP2的后半段。
“要在轮胎温度和圈末电池电量之间找到平衡总是很棘手，”这位西班牙人说。“有时如果你在最后几个弯采用不同的驾驶风格，似乎我们对本田动力单元非常敏感。”
detailEn: “High risk” and a chance of “chaos” - drivers open up on F1’s new Madring circuit
As the wild Madring circuit made its official debut on Friday, the first driver verdicts are in on Formula 1's new home of the Spanish Grand Prix
The Spanish Grand Prix's Madring circuit has received a thumbs-up from several leading Formula 1 drivers as they praised its high-commitment layout, although not everyone is as impressed.

Having sampled the 5.4km circuit on the simulator, drivers were bracing for one of the most challenging weekends of the year on a track that combines the unforgiving nature of a street circuit with plenty of medium to high-speed corners. But nothing beats the real thing, and following two one-hour practice sessions, in which drivers clearly took extra caution not to be caught out by the lack of runoff areas, the first verdicts are in on F1's newest venue.

"Honestly, it's more difficult than some tracks," said Oscar Piastri, who ended the day in fifth as McLaren struggled for performance compared to its rivals. "There's a lot of sections here where you're not really brushing up against the walls, you're kind of turning or heading at them and then you need to avoid them. So, it makes things quite challenging. Everyone is still getting up to speed, but when you get into a decent rhythm over one lap, it's pretty enjoyable."

Other than an FP2 crash for rapid Arvid Lindblad in the Racing Bulls, the day's F1 running was completed without major issues. The circuit's combined braking zones caused plenty of headaches as driver were careful to avoid lock-ups, while tyre wear, the rapidly changing grip levels and traffic proved to be some of the biggest headaches.

Ferrari's Charles Leclerc said: "It was exciting to drive on the Madrid circuit today. It’s a challenging street track, which is the type I usually enjoy and this one is no exception. I was quite impressed with the amount of grip there already was, considering that this is a completely new track with not much rubber on it so far."

As team-mate Kimi Antonelli topped the timesheets, George Russell's practice day reaffirmed his thoughts that the Madring was a "very high risk circuit", though he worried overtaking would be "very tough", a sentiment shared throughout the paddock.

The biggest positive noises came from Madrid resident Sergio Perez, who didn't have much to write home about regarding the performance of his Cadillac machine, but was effusive about the Madring both on and off the track. "Yeah, really cool track, really nice venue," the Mexican said. "Really happy to be here in Madrid. I think definitely this is going to become the best race in Europe.

"It's going to be a chaotic qualifying tomorrow and obviously a very chaotic race on Sunday, so a lot can happen. I'm really looking forward to it and as a team we just have to make sure we are able to execute a perfect weekend."
Not everyone is as enthused as Perez, though. Max Verstappen has never been the biggest admirer of street circuits, and what Madring has to offer hasn't swayed his opinion.

"Yeah, I don't know. I'm not a fan of street circuits so that will never never change," the four-time world champion said. "I will always prefer to drive on a track like Spa. I mean, what they have done in the way they have built everything up, I think they've done a really good job. But I'm not a fan of street circuits."

While the Madring isn't particularly tough on F1 2026's energy-starved power units, what is throwing things off kilter for both drivers and teams is the impact of the rapidly evolving track evolution on how their energy deployment works. That was especially difficult fro Fernando Alonso in the Honda-powered Aston Martin, who recovered from a clutch problem to complete the second half of FP2.

"It's going to be always tricky to get it right with the tyre temperature, battery state of charge at the end of the lap," the Spaniard said. "Sometimes if you do different a driving style in the last few corners, it seems that we are very sensitive to that with the Honda power unit."

items.summaryEn: Formula 1's first visit to the new Madrid circuit around the IFEMA complex produced less chaos than feared, and Max Verstappen said the organizers have done a good job while stressing he is still not a fan of street circuits.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）对F1全新马德里赛道作出的简短却耐人寻味的反应
维斯塔潘表示马德里的赛事组织者做得不错，但这位红牛车手强调，他仍然不喜欢街道赛道
Formula 1首次接触环绕马德里IFEMA会展中心的这条赛道，其混乱程度低于围场中一些人可能担心的水平。尽管F3和F2的练习赛中出现了多次撞车，甚至有一辆赛车起火，但到目前为止西班牙大奖赛中唯一的F1事故是阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）的一次撞车。
就目前而言，马德里赛道赛道在最高级别的比赛中还没有被证明是‘赛车杀手’，但这并不意味着马克斯·维斯塔潘是F1赛历上这条最新赛道的忠实粉丝。
当被问到对这条赛道的第一印象时，他只简单地回答：“嗯……
当被问到这位四届世界冠军是否只有这些要说的，他继续说道：“嗯，我不知道。我不是街道赛道的粉丝，这一点永远不会改变。我始终更喜欢在像斯帕那样的赛道上驾驶。
我是说，他们在这里所做的一切，比如他们把所有东西搭建起来的方式，我认为他们做得非常出色，但我不是街道赛道的粉丝。
红牛技术总监皮埃尔·瓦克（Pierre Wache）确实从工程角度描述了这条赛道，由于其弯道的多样性而极具挑战性。不过，他这位法国人预测，超车将是一个巨大的挑战。
“这条赛道有多种类型的弯角，从工程角度来看这很有意思，”他说。“但除此之外，超车将会非常困难，看起来是这样。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘：“我不喜欢街道赛道”
当瓦谢谈到工程师面临的挑战时，这不仅仅是因为弯角类型的多样性。车队还必须在离地间隙和车身硬度之间找到折中方案：既要足够硬以应对高速弯和倾斜弯道，又要足够软以便冲击路肩。
“是的，而且我认为还需要在不同弯角之间以及动力输出方面进行折中。有些弯角是全油门，会让轮胎产生一些打滑，这是我们必须要观察的。不过是的，这很有挑战性。”
一条新赛道理论上也带来了机会，但维斯塔潘昨天已经表示，他不认为这会给红牛带来赢下一场比赛的绝佳机会。周五的成绩印证了这一点：他排名第六，比最快的基米·安东内利慢了十分之四秒。
“从我们这边来看，这基本上就是我们的位置”，维斯塔潘说，“我们只需要在平衡性上再下一点功夫，争取在单圈中多榨出一点性能，然后看看轮胎在长距离中的表现如何。不过我猜大家的情况都差不多。”
除此之外，维斯塔潘在第二次练习赛中还遇到了动力转向的问题，但他预计这个问题不会在周末剩下的时间里困扰他。
“嗯，我是说，车还是能开的，但在第二次练习赛里感觉不太一样。不过他们会修好的。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen’s short but telling reaction to F1’s new Madrid circuit
Verstappen says the organisers in Madrid have done a good job, but the Red Bull driver stresses that he is still not a fan of street circuits

Formula 1’s first encounter with the circuit around the IFEMA complex in Madrid has produced less chaos than some in the paddock may have feared. While the F3 and F2 sessions have seen several crashes and even a car going up in flames, the only F1 incident so far at the Spanish Grand Prix has been a crash for Arvid Lindblad.
For now, then, the Madring has not proved to be a ‘car killer’ in the premier class, although that does not mean Max Verstappen is a big fan of the latest addition to the F1 calendar.
Asked for his first impression of the circuit, he simply replied: “Yeah...”

Asked whether that was all the four-time world champion had to say, he continued: “Yeah, I don't know. I'm not a fan of street circuits so that will never change. I will always prefer to drive on a track like Spa.
“I mean, what they have done here, like the way they have built everything up, I think they've done a really good job, but I'm not a fan of street circuits.”

Red Bull technical director Pierre Wache does describe the track as very challenging from an engineering point of view due to the variety of corners. Overtaking, however, is going to be an enormous challenge, the Frenchman predicts.
“It has quite a lot of types of corners and that is interesting from an engineering point of view,” he said. “But apart from that, it will be very difficult to overtake, it looks like that.”
Max Verstappen: "I'm not a fan of street circuits"

When Wache talks about the challenge for engineers, that is not only because of the variety of corner types. Teams also have to find a compromise in terms of ride height and car stiffness: stiff enough for the high-speed corners and the banking, but soft enough to attack the kerbs.

“Yeah, and I think compromising between some corners and the deployment as well. Some corners are full throttle and put some sliding on the tyres, that's something we have to see. But yeah, it's challenging.”

A new circuit theoretically offers opportunities as well, but Verstappen already said yesterday that he does not expect it to present Red Bull with a golden chance of winning a race. That picture was confirmed on Friday with sixth place, four tenths behind fastest man Kimi Antonelli.

“From our side, this is more or less where we are”, Verstappen said. “We just need to work a little bit on the balance, trying to get a bit more out of it over one lap and then see how the tyres hold up in the long run. But I guess everyone is a bit in the same boat.”
Aside from that, Verstappen also experienced an issue with the power steering in the second practice session, but he does not expect that problem to trouble him for the rest of the weekend.
“Well, I mean, it's all drivable, but it was not feeling the same [in FP2]. But they will fix it.”

detailZh: David Croft盛赞安东内利的成熟表现，F1争冠势头渐起
David Croft看好安东内利成为比维斯塔潘更年轻的一级方程式世界冠军
天空体育F1首席评论员David Croft看好梅赛德斯车手安东内利，认为他有望成为比维斯塔潘更年轻的世界冠军。
Antonelli在上周末的意大利大奖赛中奉献了一场不可思议的表现，从发车格第19位一路驾驶至主场观众面前夺冠。
这位20岁的车手成为60年来首位在蒙扎夺冠的本土车手，在本周末西班牙大奖赛前，他将对队友拉塞尔的积分领先优势扩大至66分。
在天空体育F1节目中，Croft将Antonelli当前的成长轨迹与Verstappen进行了比较，后者17岁完成F1首秀，18岁赢得首场比赛，24岁赢得首个世界冠军。
“12个月前他还在蒙扎，刚刚走出一个非常艰难的时期，从加拿大登上领奖台之后，事情开始出错，他并不开心，”Croft解释道。“他和Bono（Peter Bonnington）非常努力地试图纠正问题，然后在赛季末迎来了一段非常好的表现。”
“几乎可以说，他在经验比Max更少的情况下成长。Max在红牛车队之前，在红牛二队积累了一个赛季再加几场比赛的经验。”
“他比Max更早完成这些成就。他将成为比Max更年轻的世界冠军。他是更年轻的杆位得主。他是更年轻的分站冠军。他确实非常非常早地完成了一切，并在此过程中展现出极大的成熟。”
安东内利，梅赛德斯，维斯塔潘，红牛车队
“今年我在赛道上看到和听到了一些迹象，他在控制自己的情绪。他正在冷静下来。他把12个月前可能会让他失控的事情控制住了。”
“这就是为什么人们说这个人是世代级天才，因为拥有能力是一回事，拥有受控的能力并在一个我们三个人都同意自己绝对做不到安东内利如今所做之事的年纪开始变得非常成熟，是另一回事。”
Antonelli在中国和日本大奖赛背靠背夺冠后领跑积分榜。他在夏休前又赢得四场比赛，意大利站的胜利是他第七个F1分站冠军。
Sebastian Vettel成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，2010年他以23岁134天的年龄夺得首个世界冠军。
detailEn: David Croft hails Kimi Antonelli's maturity as F1 title charge gathers pace
David Croft has backed Kimi Antonelli to become a younger Formula 1 world champion than Max Verstappen
Sky Sports Formula 1 lead commentator David Croft has backed Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli to become a younger world champion than Max Verstappen.
Antonelli delivered an incredible performance at last weekend's Italian Grand Prix, driving from 19th on the grid to victory in front of his home crowd.
The 20-year-old became the first home driver to win at Monza in 60 years, extending his championship lead over his team-mate George Russell to 66 points ahead of this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix.

During an appearance on the Sky Sports F1 Show, Croft compared Antonelli's current trajectory to that of Verstappen, who made his F1 debut at 17, won his first race at 18 and his first championship at 24.

"12 months ago he was at Monza and was just coming out of a very difficult period where, from the podium in Canada, things had started to go wrong and he wasn't happy," Croft explained. "He was working really hard with Bono [Peter Bonnington] to try and put things right and then went on a really good run towards the end of the season.
"It's almost like he's growing up with less experience than Max. Max had that experience with Toro Rosso for a season and then a couple of races before he went up to the Red Bull team.

"He's doing things earlier than Max. He's going to be a younger world champion than Max was. He is a younger polesitter. He is a younger grand prix winner. He's getting everything done very, very early indeed and showing a lot of maturity with it.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
"I've seen and heard signs on the track this year where he's controlling his emotions. He's calming down. He's keeping a lid on things that might have got the better of him 12 months ago.

"That is why people are saying this man is a generational talent because it's one thing to have an ability, it's another to have that controlled ability and to start being very mature at an age where I think all three of us can agree we certainly wouldn't have been capable of doing anything near what Kimi Antonelli is doing."

Antonelli took the lead of the standings after back-to-back wins in the Chinese and Japanese Grands Prix. He went on to secure four more victories before the summer break and his win in Italy was his seventh F1 win.
Sebastian Vettel became the youngest F1 champion in history, claiming his first title in 2010 at the age of 23 years and 134 days.

George Russell has revealed fears over tyre wear for Sunday's Spanish Grand Prix after the first day's running at the new Madring.

The high-speed corners at the new track in Madrid are putting a lot of energy into the tyres, particularly the banked 'La Monumental' Turn 12 where the drivers carry huge speed on a 13.5-degree baking.

Russell topped first practice and his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli was fastest in second practice with Saturday's qualifying at 3pm, live on Sky Sports F1, set to be crucial given the expected difficulty of overtaking in the race.

"There's a big question mark over the tyre degradation. In FP1 with the tyre degradation we all had, we thought a six-stop race would be the fastest way!" half-joked Russell.
"I'm sure tyre degradation will be better on Sunday but with the big long La Monumental, it really hurts the tyres and that will be a challenge for everyone."

Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord confirmed the tyre temperatures on the hot Madrid circuit and the lack of straights could create problems for the teams in the race.
"You could see some unusual tyre effects because they are running so hot and you have a lot of cornering sequences without a real chance for the tyres to have a breather," he said.

"It's corner after corner after corner. How the tyres cope with that will be decisive. Even though it's a smooth surface and tyre wear may not be as high as we expect, we may see some other thermal effects that the computers beforehand might expect you to make."

Ferrari to 'shift focus' after practice learnings
Ferrari were Mercedes' closest challengers on Friday as Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were both within two tenths of pace-setter Antonelli in second practice.
Leclerc, who is yet to claim a pole position this year, says he's "looking forward to try and do something good in qualifying".
"It's been a very interesting day. A completely new track for everyone and it's very challenging. I think Qualifying will be an exciting one," he said.
"Lots of work ahead of us to try to improve the car for tomorrow but the day went well. We went through our programme and maximised the amount of laps we could do, which was one of the main targets."
Several drivers were left frustrated by Lewis Hamilton for getting in the way during first practice of the Spanish Grand Prix
Both Ferrari drivers struggled into the downhill braking zone of Turn 17, locking up several times, which team principal Frederic Vasseur suggested was down to the ever-changing conditions.
He also hinted Ferrari focused too much on long run pace and need to find time over one lap as track position will be crucial in the race.
"The long stint was as expected. It's mega difficult to overtake. It means that the positions on track at the start will be crucial," said Vasseur.
"It means also that we have to change a little bit the focus. For sure, it's better to have good pace for the race, but the position in qualifying will be it. Overall it was a decent Friday."

items.summaryZh: 据Jack Benyon报道，锦标赛领跑者安东内利在马德里赛道的第二场F1练习赛中做出最快圈速，该节练习赛因红旗中断。
items.originalTitle: 安东内利在Madring第二次练习赛中领跑，练习赛因红旗中断
items.summaryEn: According to Jack Benyon, championship leader Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap in the second F1 practice session at Madring, which was interrupted by a red flag.
detailZh: 锦标赛领跑者安东内利在马德里赛道的第二场练习赛中做出最快圈速，而西班牙大奖赛周末的首面红旗正是由截至当时该节练习赛的明星车手引发。
马德里赛道赛道在赛前被贴上“毁车赛道”的标签，车手们在FP1中表现规矩，没有发生任何事故。不幸的是，FP2中出现了红旗，损失了略少于15分钟的练习时间。
Lindblad在早期阶段多次将他驾驶的小红牛赛车带入前五，在练习赛剩余25分钟时，他在试图进入13号弯时过早失去车尾，该弯是倾斜的La Monumental弯之后的慢速左弯。
Lindblad报告自己没事，并向车队道歉。当时，下一辆“中场”赛车是奥康的哈斯，位列第八，落后0.977秒！
在Lindblad撞车后，练习赛仅剩略多于12分钟，这意味着之前的整体圈速保持不变，此后前10名中几乎没有提升。
虽然拉塞尔在FP1中做出最快圈速，但积分领跑者安东内利在FP2中似乎更胜一筹，在车队试验轮胎和调校时多次领跑圈速榜。
事实上，Russell在红旗后使用中性胎出场，这基本上注定了他只能获得红旗前的第五名。他难以拼凑出与Antonelli相当的软胎快圈，甚至在他最好的圈速中第一赛段都没有个人最佳。
相反，法拉利车手向Antonelli发起挑战，勒克莱尔落后标杆0.113秒，刚好领先于刘易斯·汉密尔顿，后者在练习赛早期前部挣扎，在17号弯出口险些撞墙。
在Lindblad和Russell之后，马克斯·维斯塔潘领先奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，两人分别是各自车队排名最高的车手，而角田裕毅有所提升，击败奥康，做出中场第二快的圈速，位列第八。
维斯塔潘的队友劳森位列第十，他抱怨车尾抓地力不足，并因撞墙损失时间，排在奥康之前。
皮亚斯特里的队友兰多·诺里斯本节练习赛表现不佳。
诺里斯因变速箱问题（他挂入了空挡）仅完成两圈，且均非全速。整个练习赛期间，赛车尾部进行了大量工作，但损失的时间将比平时更为关键，因为在这条新赛道上，赛道时间极为宝贵。
费尔南多·阿隆索是另一位遇到麻烦的车手，赛前离合器出现问题，但他确实出场并做出第17快圈速，夹在两辆威廉姆斯之间。
兰斯·斯特罗尔在另一辆阿斯顿马丁上也遇到了后期问题，被要求减速。
detailEn: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli topped the times in Madring's second practice session as the first red flag of the Spanish Grand Prix weekend was triggered by the star of the session up until that point.

The Madring circuit had been labelled a car killer in the run-up to the event, and drivers were on best behaviour with no incidents in FP1. Unfortunately, there was a red flag in FP2 as just under 15 minutes of the session was lost.

Lindblad repeatedly put his Racing Bulls up in the top five in the early running and was fourth when he lost the rear really early trying to enter Turn 13, the slow left-hander after the banked La Monumental corner, with 25 minutes remaining in the session.
Lindblad reported he was OK, and apologised to the team. At the time, the next 'midfield' car was Esteban Ocon's Haas in eighth, 0.977s behind!
After Lindblad's shunt, just over 12 minutes remained in the session, which meant the overall times from before stood with very few improvements in the top 10 after it.
While George Russell topped FP1, it was points leader Kimi Antonelli appeared to be a step ahead in FP2 and repeatedly topped the order as teams experimented with tyres and set-up.

In fact, Russell emerged from the red flag on mediums, which basically consigned him to his pre-red flag fifth. He had struggled to pull together his equivalent soft fast lap to Antonelli, lacking even a personal best first sector on his best lap.

Instead, the Ferraris challenged Antonelli with Leclerc 0.113s behind the benchmark and just ahead of Lewis Hamilton, who struggled with his front end earlier in the session, narrowly avoiding the wall at the Turn 17 exit.

Behind Lindblad and Russell, Max Verstappen led Oscar Piastri, both the highest-placed drivers in their respective teams, while Yuki Tsunoda improved to beat Ocon and set the second-best time of the midfield in eighth.
Verstappen's team-mate Lawson rounded out the top 10, complaining of a lack of rear-end grip and losing time to hitting the wall, ahead of Ocon.
Piastri's team-mate Lando Norris did not have a great session.

Norris only managed two laps on track, neither at speed, after gearbox issues where he had found a false neutral. There was a lot of work going on at the back of the car throughout the session, but the time lost will be even more crucial than normal, where track time is at a premium on what is a new track.
Fernando Alonso was another driver in trouble with pre-session clutch issues, but he did get out on track to set the 17th-best time, splitting the Williams.
Lance Stroll also had a late issue in the other Aston Martin and was told to slow.
keyPointsZh: Lindblad在FP2剩余25分钟时于13号弯失控撞车，引发红旗，损失近15分钟，他报告自己无碍并向车队道歉。
红旗前Lindblad排名第四，当时下一辆中场赛车Ocon的哈斯位列第八，落后0.977秒。
Russell在红旗后使用中性胎出场，基本锁定红旗前的第五名；勒克莱尔落后安东内利0.113秒，汉密尔顿紧随其后。
keyPointsEn: Lindblad crashed at Turn 13 with 25 minutes remaining in FP2, triggering a red flag that cost just under 15 minutes; he reported he was OK and apologised to the team.
Before the red flag, Lindblad was fourth, with the next 'midfield' car, Esteban Ocon's Haas, in eighth, 0.977s behind.
Russell emerged from the red flag on medium tyres, which essentially consigned him to his pre-red flag fifth place; Leclerc was 0.113s behind Antonelli, just ahead of Hamilton.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利领跑艰难二练，林德布拉德撞车
items.summaryZh: 在F1西班牙大奖赛第二节自由练习中，梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利做出最快圈速，力压法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔。阿尔维德·林德布拉德在练习中发生撞车，引发红旗。

items.originalTitle: F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利领跑艰难二练，林德布拉德撞车
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli topped the second practice session at the Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix, beating Ferrari's Charles Leclerc. Arvid Lindblad crashed during the session, bringing out a red flag.
detailZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：基米·安东内利领跑艰难二练，阿尔维德·林德布拉德撞车
在F1重返马德里之际，这位积分榜领跑者周五做出最快圈速，而林德布拉德成为首位在令人心惊的马德里赛道赛道撞墙的F1车手。
梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在F1西班牙大奖赛第二节自由练习中做出最快圈速，在周五下午炎热且极具挑战性的马德里赛道赛道上力压法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔。
安东内利在第二节一小时练习过半时刷出最快圈，各车手和车队则在这条难度极高的马德里赛道上逐步调整赛车设定。
这条5.4公里的赛道融合了街道赛段和一条包含多个高速弯的专用环道，从一开始就难以驾驭。由于几乎没有缓冲区，车队在一练中采取了保守的开局，牺牲了最佳圈速，让车手们适应节奏并建立肌肉记忆。
进入二练后，一些辅助措施开始被撤下，尽管抓地力水平有所提升，圈速的下降幅度并没有最初想象的那么大。
积分榜领跑者安东内利用中性胎在早期以1分34秒428的成绩领跑，但很快被红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘超越，车手们明显在努力让赛车远离护墙，同时在狭窄的混凝土围墙道路中寻找干净空气。
17号弯的右弯尤其棘手，多名车手在出弯时跑宽，触发了赛道限制违规。
兰多·诺里斯因变速箱问题在车库结束了练习。
安东内利很快以1分33秒926的圈速重新夺回领先，一练领先的队友乔治·拉塞尔落后不到0.1秒。
练习赛过半时进入高潮，大多数车手换上了最快的软胎，由于持续的横向载荷让倍耐力的轮胎承受极大压力，软胎很难保持在最佳温度范围内。
安东内利再次定下基调，这位积分榜领跑者以1分33秒662的成绩停表。拉塞尔没有立即找到回应，法拉利双雄刘易斯·汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔分列第二和第三，小红牛车队的阿尔维德·林德布拉德引人注目地排在第四。
但不久之后，林德布拉德的一天戛然而止，他在13号弯——一个中速左弯——滑入护墙。林德布拉德安然无恙，练习赛在还剩25分钟时出示红旗，赛道马歇尔紧急重新调整这位英国新秀撞歪的TecPro护栏。
部分由于这次中断，顶部排名没有再发生变化，确认安东内利领先于法拉利双雄勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿。排在第四的林德布拉德之后，拉塞尔和维斯塔潘分列第五和第六，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在卫冕世界冠军车队艰难的一天后位列第七，是迈凯伦车手中最快的。
皮亚斯特里的队友、世界冠军兰多·诺里斯仅跑了两圈就因变速箱问题回到车库，迫使迈凯伦更换变速箱。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德也不得不提前结束大部分练习。
在伊萨克·哈贾尔继续从手腕伤势中恢复期间，本赛季第三次亮相的角田裕毅在小红牛赛车中排名第八，哈斯车手埃斯特班·奥康和红牛车手利亚姆·劳森跻身前十。
正如预期，观众喜爱的卡洛斯·塞恩斯和费尔南多·阿隆索开局平静，分别位列第16和第17。阿隆索因阿斯顿·马丁修复离合器问题而延迟开始练习。
detailEn: F1 Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli leads tricky second practice as Arvid Lindblad crashes
The championship leader tops Friday running on F1's return to Madrid, as Lindblad is the first F1 driver to hit the barriers on the series' inaugural visit to the hair-raising Madring circuit
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli topped second practice at Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix, pipping Ferrari's Charles Leclerc on Friday afternoon at a hot and challenging Madring circuit.
Antonelli set the fastest lap around the halfway mark in the second one-hour session as drivers and teams gradually kept chipping away at their set-ups on the extremely difficult circuit in Madrid.

The 5.4km track, a hybrid of street portions and a purpose-built loop featuring several high-speed corners, proved tricky to tame from the outset. And with runoff virtually non-existent, teams made a conservative start to the weekend in first practice, sacrificing optimal lap time as drivers settled into a rhythm and built up muscle memory.
Some of those training wheels started to come off in FP2, although lap times didn't take as much of a tumble as first thought, despite the improving grip levels.

Championship leader Antonelli led the early running on medium tyres with a 1m34.428s effort, which was soon beaten by Red Bull's Max Verstappen as drivers visibly had their hands full both keeping their cars out of the walls and finding clear air through the narrow, concrete-lined roads.
Turn 17's right-hander proved particularly tricky as several drivers went wide on exit, triggering a track limits offence.
Lando Norris ended the session in the garage with gearbox issues
Antonelli soon reclaimed the lead with a 1m33.926s lap, with FP1 leading team-mate George Russell within a tenth.

The session went into overdrive at the halfway mark as the majority of drivers switched to the fastest soft-tyre compound, which is proving a handful to keep within optimal temperature ranges as the constant lateral loads are working Pirelli's rubber extremely hard.

Antonelli set the tone once more, the championship leader stopping the clocks after 1m33.662. Russell didn't immediately find an answer, with Ferrari duo Lewis Hamilton and Leclerc slotting into second and third, and Racing Bull's Arvid Lindblad an eye-catching fourth.

But shortly thereafter, Lindblad's day came to a screeching halt as he slid into the barriers in Turn 13, a medium-speed left-hander. Lindblad escaped unharmed as the session was red-flagged with 25 minutes to go, with track marshals rushing to undo the British rookie's TecPro barrier realignment.

Partly due to the interruption, there were no further moves at the top, confirming Antonelli's lead ahead of Ferrari duo Leclerc and Hamilton. Behind fourth-placed Lindblad, Russell and Verstappen were fifth and sixth, with Oscar Piastri first of the McLarens in seventh after a difficult day for the reigning world champions.
Piastri's team-mate, world champion Lando Norris, disappeared into the garage after just two laps with a transmission issue, forcing McLaren to change gearbox.
Arvid Lindblad also had to set out most of the session

Yuki Tsunoda, who makes his third appearance of the season as Isack Hadjar continues to recover from his wrist injury, was eighth in the Racing Bulls car, with Haas driver Esteban Ocon and Red Bull's Liam Lawson completing the top 10.

As expected, it was a quiet start for crowd favourites Carlos Sainz and Fernando Alonso, finishing 16th and 17th respectively. Alonso faced a delayed start to the session as Aston Martin repaired a clutch issue.

林德布拉德在13号弯撞墙，赛会出示红旗，他本人未受伤。
兰多·诺里斯因变速箱问题仅跑了两圈便回到车库，迈凯伦被迫更换变速箱。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli set the fastest lap of 1m33.662s on soft tyres around the halfway mark of FP2.
Lindblad crashed into the barriers at Turn 13, causing a red flag; he was unharmed.
Lando Norris returned to the garage after just two laps with a transmission issue, forcing McLaren to change the gearbox.

世界锦标赛领先者基米·安东内利在F1西班牙大奖赛马德里新赛道的首日运行中做出最快圈速，而马德林赛道极具挑战性的特点也因英国新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德的严重撞车而显露无遗。
在当天第一节练习赛中被梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔压制后，安东内利在二练中做出1:33.662的更快圈速，以略多于0.1秒的优势力压法拉利双雄查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
成绩表进一步证明了安东内利极高的自信心，上周末他在意大利大奖赛上从第19位发车赢得主场胜利，将他在积分榜上对拉塞尔的领先优势扩大到66分，2026赛季还剩10站比赛。

从周五练习赛的情况来看，梅赛德斯和法拉利实力接近，可能在周六排位赛中上演激动人心的杆位争夺，西班牙首都充满巨大兴奋，因为F1自1981年以来首次重返该城市。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德在二练13号弯严重撞车，引发马德林赛道首次红旗
许多人此前预测周五——以及整个周末剩余时间——会出现大量红旗，因为这条赛道狭窄且极具惩罚性，所有车手都从未在此比赛过。
虽然周五的F2和F3比赛中出现了多次撞车和红旗，但F1车手展现了他们的高超水平，在一练中避免了任何重大事故，然而林德布拉德在二练刚过半程后便遭遇了麻烦。
这位19岁车手表现令人印象深刻，刚刚升至第四位，但在下一圈飞驰圈中推得太猛，在13号弯失控，高速旋转撞向护栏。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德在周五练习赛撞车后形容马德林赛道“不是一条容易的赛道”。
林德布拉德表示：“这不是一条容易的赛道。我们都在努力寻找极限。这对我们所有人来说都是新的。只是犯了个小错误，在13号弯做得过头了。很遗憾。我向机械师和车队道歉。今晚他们要多干活了。”
“但从大局来看，这是不错的一天。我们非常快。我凭实力跑到第四，距离第一只有0.2秒，这非常强。”
“对车队进入明天充满信心。我只专注于重置，试着把它抛在脑后，吸取所有好的经验。”
F2的塔萨纳波尔·因特拉普瓦萨克在赛车起火后安然走开！
超过10分钟的中断结束了当时正在进行的排位赛模拟，确保了安东内利在成绩表榜首的位置。
拉塞尔在似乎难以优化赛车调校后排名第五，但仍力压红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘和迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
“第一次驾驶这条赛道很有趣，”拉塞尔说。“驾驶新赛道总是很棒的体验。”
“一练是强劲的一节。二练我们做了一些调校改动，效果不太好，所以我们可能会改回去。到目前为止一切顺利。”
车手们在周五练习赛后分享对马德林赛道的第一印象。
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯因变速箱故障仅跑两圈便退出本节，未能做出时间。
鉴于诺里斯在安东内利蒙扎夺冠前取得背靠背胜利，迈凯伦本被预期在马德里具有竞争力，但周五几乎没有证据表明这一点。
虽然诺里斯近期总体比皮亚斯特里更快，但在新赛道损失整个一节练习赛将使这位英国车手在进入周六时处于不利位置。

detailEn: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli edges Ferrari in Madrid practice as Arvid Lindblad suffers first F1 crash at challenging Madring circuit

Kimi Antonelli fastest from Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton in Practice Two; Arvid Lindblad first F1 driver to crash at new Madrid track; watch Spanish GP Qualifying from the all-new Madring circuit live on Sky Sports F1 at 3pm on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Spanish Grand Prix

World championship leader Kimi Antonelli was fastest on Formula 1's first day of running at the Spanish Grand Prix's new Madrid circuit as the hugely challenging nature of the Madring was exhibited by a big crash for British rookie Arvid Lindblad.

After being outpaced by his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in the day's first session, Antonelli produced a quicker time of 1:33.662 in Practice Two to edge out Ferrari duo Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton by little more than a tenth of a second.

The timesheet was further evidence of Antonelli's sky-high confidence, which was elevated by a stunning victory at the Italian Grand Prix last weekend as he won his home race from 19th on the grid to move 66 points clear of Russell at the top of the standings with 10 rounds of the 2026 season remaining.

On the evidence of Friday's sessions, Mercedes and Ferrari are closely matched and could deliver an exciting pole contest in qualifying on Saturday, with huge excitement in the Spanish capital as F1 returns to the city for the first time since 1981.
Arvid Lindblad brought out the first red flag at the Madring track after this heavy crash on turn 13 during second practice
Many had predicted a high number of red flags on Friday - and throughout the rest of the weekend - due to the tight and punishing nature of a circuit that the field have never raced at before.

While there were several crashes and red flags in Friday's F2 and F3 sessions, the F1 drivers showed their excellence to avoid any major incidents in first practice, but it was Lindblad who came unstuck just beyond the halfway point of Practice Two.
The 19-year-old was driving impressively and had just elevated himself to fourth when he pushed too hard on his next flying lap, losing control at Turn 13 and spinning into the barrier at high speed.
Arvid Lindblad describes the Madring circuit as 'not an easy track' following his crash during Friday's practice.

Lindblad said: "It's not an easy track. We are all pushing to find the limits. It's new for all of us. Just made a bit of a mistake and overdid it in Turn 13. A shame. I apologise to the mechanics and the team. It's extra work for them tonight.
"But looking at the big picture, it's been a good day. We are very fast. I was running P4 on merit and was only two tenths from P1 which is really strong.
"A lot of confidence in the team going into tomorrow. I'm just focused on resetting and trying to block it out and taking all the good learnings."

A delay of just over 10 minutes put an end to the qualifying simulations that had been taking place at that stage, securing Antonelli's position at the top of the timesheet.
Russell was fifth after appearing to struggle to optimise his setup, but still managed to edge out Red Bull's Max Verstappen and McLaren's Oscar Piastri.
"It was fun to drive the track for the first time," Russell said. "It's always a great experience driving a new circuit.
"FP1 was a strong session. FP2 we made some setup changes which weren't quite as good, so we will probably revert back on that. So far so good."
Drivers share their first thoughts of the Madring circuit after friday's practice.
Reigning world champion Lando Norris was unable to set a time after a gearbox failure took him out of the session after just two laps.
McLaren were expected to be competitive in Madrid given Norris had claimed back-to-back victories before Antonelli's win in Monza, but there was little evidence of that on Friday.
While Norris has generally been quicker than Piastri recently, losing an entire session at a new circuit will put the Brit on the back foot going into Saturday.

detailZh: 胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚表示，马德里赛道是2026年F1赛历中第一条他想驾驶的赛道。
胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚对马德里赛道赛道给予好评，称其富有挑战性的布局让他想重新坐进驾驶舱。
前F1车手胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚对全新的马德里赛道赛道给予好评，透露这是2026赛季第一条让他想重新坐进驾驶舱的赛道。
上周末在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛中，梅赛德斯由基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔包揽前二。此后车手们将面对这条位于西班牙首都、全长5.4公里、共22个弯的全新半街道赛道，踏入未知领域。
在马德里赛道比赛周末前，蒙托亚在F1 TV的Weekend Warm-Up节目中分享了他完成赛道步行后的兴奋之情。
“我今天早上走了一圈，几周前还开过一辆公路车。我已经看过它几次了，”这位哥伦比亚人解释道。“难以置信。说实话，我经常进行赛道步行，因为我的孩子参加F2比赛，所以我们每场比赛都会走赛道，但这是我第一次想，‘哦，我想开这条赛道。’”
“在我们今年去过的所有赛道中，这是我第一次想，‘这将会是难以置信的。’我认为赛道图无法体现它的精髓，因为存在海拔变化和盲区。”
“很多弯道是旧式风格，内外都有护墙，而且都是盲弯。你在转弯，而离弯心越近的人就是离墙越近的人，我认为这带来了很多很酷的东西，因为当你把弯心打开时，任何人都能做到。”
“任何人都可以走宽线，这里一点那里一点，但如果你把护墙放在那里，你就必须做到完美。我认为这就是你需要带来的投入程度。太不可思议了。”
detailEn: Juan Pablo Montoya says Madring is first 2026 F1 track he wants to drive
Juan Pablo Montoya has praised the Madring circuit, saying its challenging layout have made him want to get back behind the wheel
Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has praised the brand-new Madring circuit, revealing that it is the first track of the 2026 season that has made him want to get back behind the wheel.

After the Italian Grand Prix at Monza last weekend, which resulted in a Mercedes 1-2 finish with Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, the drivers now face a step into the unknown at the new 5.4km, 22-turn layout semi-street circuit in the Spanish capital.
Speaking on F1 TV's Weekend Warm-Up show ahead of the race weekend at Madring, Montoya shared his excitement after completing a track walk.

"I walked it this morning, and I've been in a road car a couple of weeks ago. I've seen it a few times," the Colombian explained. "Unbelievable. Honestly, I do a lot of track walks because my kid races in Formula 2, so we do track walks every race, and this was the first time I went, 'Oo, I would like to drive this.'
"Out of all the tracks we've been to this year, it's the first time I've gone, 'This would be unbelievable.' I don't think the track map does it justice because of the elevation and the blindness.

"A lot of the corners are old-style, with barriers inside and out, and they're blind corners. You're turning, and the guy who gets closer to the apex is the guy who is closest to the wall, and I think that brings a lot of cool things because when you open the apexes, anybody can do it.

"Anybody can run a wide line, a little here, a little there, but if you put a barrier on it, you've got to be perfect. And I think that is just the level of commitment you need to bring. It's incredible."
